protocol.selection: At least 12 Jan-Feb trades preferred; maximize worst marked month, then total net, then name. No March-April input.
protocol.evaluation: Record unchanged baseline before Jan-Feb tuning; freeze selected settings before March-April; show baseline and selected with no holdout reselection
protocol.gate: Both development months positive, >=12 development trades; holdout >=20 trades, net>0, PF>=1.15, marked DD<=5%, weekly bootstrap lower95>0, doubled-cost replay net>0
protocol.ratio: 1:1 price distances; unchanged risk and portfolio controls
